findings.text: The docs model card is a product page (specs, features, weights), not a safety or evaluation report.

source.quote: Our best multilingual open source model released July 2024.

findings.text: Open weights are released under Apache 2.0, with Hugging Face links for Instruct, Base, and FP8 Instruct weights.
The model is marked deprecated on the docs page, with deprecation date 5/22/2026 and replacement Ministral 3 8B.

source.quote: This model is deprecated. Use Ministral 3 8B for new integrations.

findings.text: The page header links to the July 18, 2024 Blog post for the release announcement.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-nemo-12b-24-07). It is a product/model catalog page (date, context, license, params, modalities, features, weights), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header Modalities Text input/Text output, Context 128k, Weights table Parameters/Active both 12, Context Size 128k). Seed document mistral-nemo-blog (https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-nemo) has Table 1 base-model scores vs Gemma 2 9B / Llama 3 8B and Table 2 instruct MT Bench / WildBench as images, plus multilingual/tokenizer figures; seed-lookup listed only this docs document for the card (blog kind is outside the card group), so blog numbers were not included. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty. Header date July 18, 2024 treated as releaseDate following other Mistral docs cards; page also says released July 2024.
